intent: Rename the pi-compaction review notice to Tool review (Pi can route review to any classifier). During a Lune compaction with review enabled, show one progress row above the editor (widget lune-compaction-review; preparing, request progress, then edits while summarizing) and clear it when the run completes, fails or is cancelled, or on session change, so nothing stays pinned. After a committed review, append a custom session entry lune-compaction-review (validated versioned record: counts, protected categories, sizes) one macrotask after session_compact so it renders below Pi's rebuilt compaction summary; register an entry renderer that shows one collapsed row and up to three expanded rows (Ctrl+O), with width series that drop whole parts and never cut. No entry without UI or on failure/cancel; RPC gets the progress row as string lines. Raise pi-compaction's Pi pins to 1.4.0 (peer pi-coding-agent >=1.4.0) because registerEntryRenderer is new in 1.4.0, keeping the lockfile change limited to pi-compaction; update host tests for Pi 1.4.0 native compact() changes (no sized summary maxTokens, custom instructions also in turn-prefix prompt). npm run check passed on the branch (2562 tests, exit 0).

findings.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md:80 still says to pin Pi SDK dev dependencies to 1.3.0 across the workspace so shared classes and branded types resolve to one version. This diff pins only pi-compaction to 1.4.0 (lines 39-42, with nested 1.4.0 copies in package-lock.json), and every other workspace stays on 1.3.0. Update the rule or record the exception.
findings.resolution: Pi pins reverted to 1.3.0 in 8b07196; CONTRIBUTING's single-version rule holds again.

findings.summary: Raising the pi-coding-agent peer from >=1.0.4 (published 0.1.0, per `npm view @lune_99/pi-compaction versions peerDependencies`) to >=1.4.0 is breaking, but this bullet lacks the **BREAKING:** marker that AGENTS.md:49 requires. pi-shell-inspector CHANGELOG.md:114 marks the same kind of peer raise as BREAKING.
findings.resolution: Peer back to pi-coding-agent >=1.0.4 in 8b07196; the 1.4.0 bullet is removed, so no breaking change remains.

findings.summary: The appended entry becomes the branch tail, so Pi's trailing-compaction guard in compact() and prepareCompaction() stops firing. A scratch host probe (startJevHost, compact twice) shows the second /compact failing with 'Nothing to compact (session too small)' when a UI is bound, against 'Already compacted' without one. The README and CHANGELOG do not mention this.
findings.resolution: Kept by design: a display entry has to follow the checkpoint and Pi still refuses the second compaction. The changed message is now documented in the CHANGELOG (8b07196).

findings.summary: 2 instances: line 531 `!after.includes("preparing") || after.includes("summarizing")` is always true for a summarizing view. Line 373 asserts the middle-width details row only `if (rows.length === 2)`, so losing that row at widths 49-71 still passes; only width 48 is covered, by the model-drop test.
findings.resolution: Summarizing row asserts summarizing and not preparing; widths 48-71 assert two rows with edit counts unconditionally (8b07196).

findings.summary: 2 instances: a 0 ms timer is not tied to compaction_end, so the entry is not reliably under the summary. (a) A prompt queued during compaction, sent on compaction_end as flushCompactionQueue does, lands first: a scratch host test saved compaction, user:QUEUED_PROMPT, assistant, review. (b) A later session_compact handler awaiting 5 ms put entry_appended before compaction_end: drawn above.
findings.resolution: Entry appended synchronously inside session_compact (8b07196); new host test checks compaction, entry, queued prompt order and fails with the old setTimeout.

findings.summary: 3 instances: peer >=1.4.0 (package.json:35), CHANGELOG.md:31 and README.md:13 say registerEntryRenderer needs Pi 1.4.0, but Pi 1.3.0 has it with the same signature (root loader.js:284, types.d.ts:1254; Pi added entry renderers in 0.80.4). The new src typechecks against 1.3.0 (tsc with paths to root node_modules, exit 0), so the bump locks out Pi 1.0.4-1.3.x for no reason.
findings.resolution: Same root cause as F1-2: registerEntryRenderer exists in Pi 1.3.0, pins and peer reverted in 8b07196.

findings.summary: CONTRIBUTING.md:80 still says to pin Pi SDK dev dependencies to 1.3.0 across the workspace so classes and branded types resolve to one version. This diff pins pi-compaction to 1.4.0 (package.json:39-42; lockfile nests 1.4.0 under packages/pi-compaction while root stays 1.3.0), so the documented rule no longer holds. Either keep 1.3.0 or document the exception.
findings.resolution: Same root cause as F1-1, resolved by the 1.3.0 revert in 8b07196.
